faqs.q: Can you repair my washer the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. Same-day washer repair is available across Houston and nearby cities. Book online or give us a call and a technician is scheduled that day.

faqs.q: Why won’t my washing machine drain?
faqs.a: The most common causes are a clogged drain pump filter, a small item stuck in the pump, a kinked drain hose or a failed pump. A technician can confirm which one and fix it.

faqs.q: Why is my front-load washer door locked?
faqs.a: The door stays locked while water remains in the drum or while the machine thinks a cycle is running. A drain problem or a failed door lock assembly are the usual reasons.

faqs.q: Do you repair both top-load and front-load washers?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair top-load, front-load and stacked washers from all major brands, including Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, Maytag and GE.
Yes. You get a free estimate before any work starts, so you know the price and decide whether to go ahead.

faqs.q: What warranty do washer repairs have?
faqs.a: Washer repairs are covered by our 90-day warranty on parts and labor.

faqs.q: Is it worth repairing my washer instead of buying a new one?
faqs.a: Pumps, belts, lid switches, door locks and shocks are contained repairs that usually make sense. For major failures on an older washer, we explain the options so you can compare with the free estimate in hand.
